title: Sensational.
body: A mental health, habit tracker , and garden all at once! I was pleasantly suprised with an easily navigable interface, and a not money hungry subscription? You can either get it for a really cheap price yearly , or forever for just 15 $. Oh my god! Eden became my safe space, and I think anyone can try, and maybe agree.
author: Aurlion219
